correctness.rationale: For τ≠0, the cyclic adjacency decomposes into reflection-even/odd sectors. An onsite rank-one perturbation couples to each even Fourier mode and makes its Jacobi spectrum simple, with no overlap with unchanged odd eigenvalues. Every squared eigenvector is reflection invariant so rank≤m+1 where m=⌊n/2⌋. The vectors 1,d1,d3,…,d_{2m−1} have triangular restriction to distance shells because an odd closed walk of length <n must visit the mark and stay; the diagonal entries are τ and the determinant is exactly (−1)^m τ^m. Thus rank≥m+1. For τ=0, standard cycle Fourier projector formulas give ranks n (odd) and n/2 (even). Independently generated Hτ powers and checked determinant for n=3..8 and τ=1,-2. Numerical checks are finite only.

value.rationale: A single diagonal defect is a canonical minimal perturbation of a quantum ring. The opposite parity rank jump and exact polynomial moment determinant describe a sharply discontinuous long-time mixing invariant and give an intrinsic spectral-free certificate for every n,τ≠0. A complete natural classification is valuable independently of downstream applications.
